Tightening The average net percentage of domestic respondents to the Federal Reserve Board’s Senior Loan Officer

Opinion Survey reporting tightening standards in year t�1 for commercial and industrial loans.
Tightening is the percentage reporting tightening minus the percentage reporting loosening. Positive

banks),’’ (4) Measure: ‘‘Net percent tightening standards,’’ (5) Terms: ‘‘NA Inquiries, demand, standards
